findings: Eighteen geometry views inspected before final acceptance. Paper faces meet at taped perimeter, 10 cm diameter and 2.4 cm illustrative thickness; face marks on the front are hidden by the rear surface after winding correction. Flat paint removes fragmented shading.

Lip balm uses nominal supplier 12.7 mm width and 66 mm closed height. Model shows open tube around 60 mm with collar, flat balm tip and detached hollow cap on common ground plane. Camera roll 40 degrees changes presentation without changing physical dimensions.

Unit cube has exact shared face vertices. Original flat window, selection corners and cursor surround its orthographic projection. Other flat pictograms are an applicator and drill grid, and a phone with pause/time symbols.

Five native cards, nine accepted/Noto cards and ten final IconManager variants inspected. Four candidate hashes unchanged after lip-balm revision. Structural references are text-only; no reference photo or template traced.
No anatomy, physical simulation, exact workshop kit or ingredient/health claim.
